item.title: 'VPNs are lawful technical tools,' says EU Court in landmark copyright ruling
item.description:

item.title: RFC 8890 – The Internet is for End Users (2020)
item.description:

Is that OK if it’s merely technically sound. A community that agrees to principles that are.

item.title: GCC steering committee announces AI policy
item.description:
📝 The GCC steering committee has announced that it has accepted an AI contributions policy recommended by the GCC AI policy working group. The policy, in part, states that the project will decline any "legally significant contributions which include LLM-generated content or are derived from LLM-generated content". The committee says that it expects the policy will evolve and will be revisited periodically.
🔗 Read more: https://lwn.net/Articles/1086041/
